column1: # int-rulings.tsv: owner rulings on forks of the groups, recorded here because a FRAGMENT is not edited by the integrator.
# Columns: fork id, group, option ruled, condition, the owner's words verbatim, date, how the ruling reached the integrator.
# int-gen-forks.py adds each row to the fork index in NOTES.md, and NOTES.md carries the same line in its section "Owner rulings".

column3: default: the later of the two DATES, so day X (the commencement day of s.63(a)(1)) is 16 July 2025; the alternative (three months from the LATER of the two days, day X 16 October 2025) stays callable
column5: Use 16 July but document the 16 Oct alternative in the forks register or in notes.
column7: relayed by the fleet lead in a message to the integrator; no bench
